name: Guardian
description: Requires guarded users (user 1 by default) to log in only via password reset or drush uli, and reverts any change to their email/password.
project_description: Guardian forces specified 'guarded users' (user 1 / uid 1 by default, plus any accounts declared via hook_guardian_guarded_users) to authenticate only through a one-time login link — a `/user/password` reset email or `drush uli [uid]` — rather than a stored username/password. It removes the password as an entry point: on every save of a guarded account it pins the account's mail and init to the address in `$settings['guardian_mail']` and sets the password to NULL, so a leaked or guessed password is worthless and there is no need to store or share complex admin passwords within an organization. Guarded users are also force-logged-out after a configurable inactivity window (default 2 hours, `$settings['guardian_hours']`), and cron restores any guarded account whose credentials were changed out of band. Enabling or disabling the module sends a notification (with client IP, host and, on CLI, the terminal user) to the guardian_mail address.
